topic: Metals: types and properties of steel, alloys

questions.q: 259. The property of steel enabling it to be drawn into thin wires is called
questions.explain: Ductility is the physical property of a material associated with the ability to be hammered thin or stretched into wire without breaking.

questions.q: 260. The Property of metals because of which they can be transformed into different shapes by heating is called
questions.explain: Malleability is the ability of a metal to be deformed under compression, often improved by heating, allowing it to be rolled or hammered into sheets.

questions.q: 261. The property due to which steel can withstand hammer blows is called
questions.explain: Toughness is the ability of a material to absorb energy and deform plastically without fracturing, essential for resisting impact or hammer blows.

questions.q: 262. The operation of removal of impurities or clay adhering to iron ores is known as
questions.explain: Dressing involves the mechanical removal of impurities like clay and stones from the ore before chemical processing.

questions.q: 263. Pig iron made from haematite are free from sulphur, phosphorus and copper is known as
questions.explain: Bessemer pig iron is high-quality pig iron low in phosphorus and sulphur, specifically suitable for the Bessemer steel-making process.

questions.q: 264. The pig iron obtained from the furnace that is property provided with fuel at very high temperature is called
questions.explain: Foundry pig iron is produced under conditions that allow it to be easily remelted and cast into various shapes.

questions.q: 265. The pig iron obtained from the furnace that is property provided with insufficient fuel at very low temperature is called
questions.explain: Forge pig iron is produced at lower temperatures and is generally used for making wrought iron.

questions.q: 266. The process involved in the manufacture of wrought iron from pig iron is known as
questions.explain: Wrought iron manufacture involves refining the pig iron, 'puddling' to remove carbon, and rolling to create the fibrous structure.

questions.q: 267. For melting one tonne of cast iron the requirement of material is
questions.explain: The melting process in a cupola furnace requires specific ratios of fuel (coke), flux (limestone), and air for combustion.

questions.q: 268. Pig iron contains carbon up to
questions.explain: Pig iron is the immediate product of smelting iron ore and has a very high carbon content, typically between 3% and 5%.

questions.q: 269. The property of steel is influenced maximum by
questions.explain: Carbon content is the primary factor that determines the hardness, strength, and ductility of steel.

questions.q: 270. Purest form of iron is
questions.explain: Wrought iron contains less than 0.15% carbon and very few impurities, making it the purest commercial form of iron.

questions.q: 271. As compared to mild steel, cast iron has
questions.explain: Cast iron is brittle; it is very strong in compression but fails easily under tension compared to the ductile mild steel.

questions.q: 272. Wrought iron contains carbon up to
questions.explain: To maintain its purity and fibrous nature, wrought iron carbon content is strictly limited, usually below 0.15%.

questions.q: 273. Mild steel contains carbon up to
questions.explain: Mild steel (low carbon steel) typically has a carbon range of 0.15% to 0.25%.

questions.q: 274. The unit weight of steel in taken as
questions.explain: The standard density of steel used in engineering calculations is approximately 7850 kg/m3 or 7.85 ton/m3.

questions.q: 275. Vanadium steel in generally used for
questions.explain: Vanadium increases the fatigue strength and toughness of steel, making it ideal for high-stress automotive parts like axles and springs.

questions.q: 276. Cast iron is used for
questions.explain: Because cast iron is excellent in compression, it was historically used for vertical members like columns and struts.

questions.q: 277. Mild steel is used for
questions.explain: Mild steel's high tensile strength and ductility make it the standard material for structural beams and reinforcement.

questions.q: 278. Wrought iron is used for
questions.explain: Wrought iron's corrosion resistance made it a popular choice for water pipes and decorative ironwork before the advent of galvanized steel.

questions.q: 279. The types of steel used for precision leveling staff in
questions.explain: Invar has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, ensuring that precision leveling staffs do not change length with temperature.

questions.q: 280. The steel used for rails under heavy traffic and sharp curves in
questions.explain: Manganese steel (Hadfield steel) is 'work-hardening,' meaning it gets harder as it is impacted, making it perfect for heavy-duty rails.

questions.q: 281. The steel used for manufacture of rails in
questions.explain: Bessemer steel was historically the primary material for rails because the process allowed for the economical production of large quantities of steel with the necessary hardness.

questions.q: 282. Softer variety of steel may be obtained by
questions.explain: The crucible process allows for high control over the composition, often used to produce high-quality, uniform tool steel or softer, specialized varieties.

questions.q: 283. Brass is an alloy of
questions.explain: Brass is a non-ferrous alloy primarily consisting of copper and zinc. The proportions can be varied to achieve different mechanical and electrical properties.

questions.q: 284. Bronze is as alloy of
questions.explain: Bronze is an alloy consisting primarily of copper, usually with tin as the main additive, making it harder and more durable than pure copper.

questions.q: 285. Invar is an alloy of
questions.explain: Invar (FeNi36) is a nickel-iron alloy notable for its uniquely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it essential for precision instruments.

questions.q: 286. Solder is an alloy of
questions.explain: Soft solder is typically an alloy of lead and tin, characterized by a low melting point used to join metal workpieces.

questions.q: 287. German silver is an alloy of
questions.explain: Despite its name, German silver contains no actual silver; it is composed of copper, nickel, and zinc, resembling silver in appearance.

questions.q: 288. Monel metal is an alloy of
questions.explain: Monel is a group of nickel alloys, primarily composed of nickel (up to 67%) and copper, with small amounts of iron, manganese, carbon, and silicon.

questions.q: 289. Stainless steel resists corrosion due to
questions.explain: Chromium reacts with oxygen to form a thin, invisible, and self-healing layer of chromium oxide, which protects the steel from rusting.

questions.q: 290. For the manufacture of stainless steel, steel is mixed width
questions.explain: Chromium is the essential alloying element (at least 10.5%) that transforms steel into stainless steel.

questions.q: 291. Galvanizing means
options: depositing a fine film of zinc on iron/steel by dipping it in molten zinc
questions.explain: Galvanization is the process of applying a protective zinc coating to steel or iron to prevent rusting.

questions.q: 292. A combination of metals with other substances is called
questions.explain: An alloy is a metallic substance composed of two or more elements, as either a compound or a solution.

questions.q: 293. The main purpose of manufacture of alloys steel is to attain a certain properties like
questions.explain: Alloying elements are added to steel to improve various characteristics, including mechanical strength, hardness, and impact resistance (toughness).

questions.q: 417. Aluminium is extensively used in aeroplane industries because
options: its tensile strength is very low
it is very tough and light metal
questions.explain: Aluminum's high strength-to-weight ratio (tough but lightweight) makes it the primary material for aircraft construction.

questions.q: 429. The crudest form of iron is
questions.explain: Cast iron (or Pig iron directly from the furnace) is the crudest form, containing high carbon content and impurities.

questions.q: 430. The process at which steel is passed through a small hole to make cylindrical rods and wires is
questions.explain: as per key c but Drawing is the manufacturing process used to reduce the cross-section of a wire or rod by pulling it through a die.

questions.q: 435. Addition of chromium to steel makes it
questions.explain: Chromium increases the corrosion resistance and can enhance the elasticity and hardness of steel.

questions.q: 436. Major component of a gun metal is
questions.explain: Gunmetal is a type of bronze primarily composed of Copper (88%), with Tin and Zinc.

questions.q: 438. In mild steel, carbon content is
questions.explain: Mild steel is low carbon steel, containing approximately 0.05% to 0.25% carbon.

questions.q: 440. Bulb angles are used in
questions.explain: Bulb angles provide high stiffening capacity and are predominantly used in the framing of ships.

questions.q: 443. Wrought iron contains carbon upto
questions.explain: Wrought iron is the purest form of commercial iron, with carbon content usually less than 0.15%.

questions.q: 445. Expanded metal is obtained from
questions.explain: Expanded metal is produced by slitting and stretching a metal sheet, often galvanized steel, to form a diamond-shaped mesh.

questions.q: 447. Depending on the chemical composition and mechanical properties, iron may be classified as
questions.explain: Iron is classified into these three main categories based on the percentage of carbon present.
